PowerShell($body = '{"secteur":"Informatique / Tech","region":"Paris","taille":"toutes"}' ; $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes\($body\) ; $req = [System.Net.WebRequest]::Create\("http://localhost:3000/api/prospection"\) ; $req.Method = "POST" ; $req.ContentType = "application/json" ; $req.ContentLength = $bytes.Length ; $stream = $req.GetRequestStream\(\) ; $stream.Write\($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length\) ; $stream.Close\(\) ; try { $resp = $req.GetResponse\(\) ; $reader = [System.IO.StreamReader]::new\($resp.GetResponseStream\(\)\) ; $content = $reader.ReadToEnd\(\) ; Write-Host "Status: $\($resp.StatusCode\)" ; Write-Host \($content | Select-Object -First 500\) } catch [System.Net.WebException] { $errResp = $_.Exception.Response ; Write-Host "HTTP $\([int]$errResp.StatusCode\)" ; $reader = [System.IO.StreamReader]::new\($errResp.GetResponseStream\(\)\) ; Write-Host $reader.ReadToEnd\(\) })

PowerShell($web = [System.Net.WebRequest]::Create\("https://recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr/search?q=informatique&per_page=3&departement=75&tranche_effectif_min=10"\) ; $web.Method = "GET" ; try { $r = $web.GetResponse\(\) ; $reader = [System.IO.StreamReader]::new\($r.GetResponseStream\(\)\) ; $content = $reader.ReadToEnd\(\) ; $r.Close\(\) ; Write-Host "Status: OK" ; $content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(800, $content.Length\)\) } catch [System.Net.WebException] { Write-Host "FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($keyword = [System.Uri]::EscapeDataString\("informatique développement numérique logiciel"\) ; $url = "https://recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr/search?q=$keyword&per_page=3&departement=75&tranche_effectif_min=10" ; Write-Host "URL: $url" ; $web = [System.Net.WebRequest]::Create\($url\) ; $web.Method = "GET" ; try { $r = $web.GetResponse\(\) ; $reader = [System.IO.StreamReader]::new\($r.GetResponseStream\(\)\) ; $content = $reader.ReadToEnd\(\) ; $r.Close\(\) ; Write-Host "Response length: $\($content.Length\)" ; $content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(500, $content.Length\)\) } catch [System.Net.WebException] { Write-Host "FAIL: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" ; $errResp = $_.Exception.Response ; if \($errResp\) { $reader = [System.IO.StreamReader]::new\($errResp.GetResponseStream\(\)\) ; Write-Host $reader.ReadToEnd\(\) } })
